note: The first-time tutorial for Owner Mode: one short step per screen. `tab` is the tab shown while the step is open. Edit the text here; no code change needed.

steps.title: Welcome, owner
steps.text: You own a basketball franchise. You cannot be fired: the game is about building a winning team and a valuable business over many seasons. You decide how the money is spent, who runs the team, and when to change things. This short tour shows where everything is. You can close it at any time and reopen it with the Help button.

steps.title: The Overview
steps.text: This is your team at a glance: record, money, what your owners' approval is, and what to do next. Approval rises when you win more than expected and your franchise value grows. Check it after each season.

steps.title: Your roster
steps.text: Your players and their contracts. A player whose deal ends this season LEAVES unless you extend him (the Roster tab has the button, and your general manager can do it for you). Injured players are marked, and you may release or sign players at any time within the roster limits.

steps.title: The money
steps.text: Tickets, shop, sponsors and TV bring money in; salaries, staff and the arena cost it. Start with the ticket price: press 'Use suggestion' to charge the price that just fills your arena. Season tickets and promotion nights help when seats stay empty. Arena projects and your own dividends are further down. A loss becomes debt, and debt costs interest.

steps.title: Your staff
steps.text: A general manager can handle contracts, the draft, free agents and trades for you, and a good negotiator gets cheaper deals. Coaches develop your players; a business executive improves sponsors and costs. Staff chemistry shows how well they work together, and the hiring list previews the chemistry each candidate would give.

steps.title: Playing the season
steps.text: Use Next Day, Next Week, Next Month or To End of Regular Season at the top. Watch the Standings and your Schedule. Then the playoffs begin. Save from the top bar whenever you like.

steps.title: The offseason
steps.text: After the playoffs press 'Begin Offseason'. First the owners' meeting (see below), then the draft: your scouts' board is in the Draft tab and you can pick for yourself or let the staff do it. Then the free-agency window opens to you before the AI teams. When you are done press 'Finish Offseason and Start Next Season'.

steps.title: Free agents and trades
steps.text: The Market tab lists free agents: offer a salary and years, and a player accepts only if the offer is good enough for him. The Trades tab is where you swap players and draft picks with other teams; AI teams also send you offers. A team you trade with remembers it and asks for more next time.

steps.title: The owners' meeting
steps.text: Once a year the owners vote on rule changes: the cap, the schedule, revenue sharing, expansion and more. You have one vote and some influence points to lobby other owners or to add a proposal of your own, including moving your franchise to a city you choose and renaming the team. Owners remember who backed them.

steps.title: Over many seasons
steps.text: The league grows with the years: prices and the salary cap rise with inflation, players age and retire, new stars are drafted. The History and League tabs show champions and records. Good luck!
